title: COT Logged-out Facebook Proof Validator Input

startUrls.title: Facebook business pages or posts
startUrls.description: Facebook page or post URLs to validate in legacy mode. Batched callers may supply requests instead.

lead.title: Lead record
lead.description: Optional Card-data lead fields used to preserve source context.

activityWindowDays.title: Activity window (days)
activityWindowDays.description: A business passes the activity check when qualifying activity is within this window.

maxPosts.title: Maximum recent posts
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of recent business-authored activity records to return.

includeContactDetails.title: Extract contact details
includeContactDetails.description: Extract phone, email, address, and website evidence from the Facebook business page.

includeGoogleFallback.title: Google official-site fallback
includeGoogleFallback.description: When Facebook has no verified contact details, search for an identity-matched official business website.

contactRequirements.title: Required contact evidence
contactRequirements.description: COT callers use phone_address to seek missing phone and structured address evidence even when email is available. Existing callers retain the any-contact fallback policy.

includePageDetails.title: Extract page details
includePageDetails.description: Extract page identity, category, and trading-status evidence.

includePreviousPosts.title: Extract recent activity
includePreviousPosts.description: Extract recent business-authored activity evidence for the validation window.

useResidentialProxy.title: Use residential proxy for Facebook
useResidentialProxy.description: Route Facebook reads through residential exit IPs. Each retry draws a new IP, which is what clears the contentless shell page Facebook serves at random.

facebookProxyCountry.title: Facebook proxy country (ignored)
facebookProxyCountry.description: Ignored. Exit countries are chosen automatically for latency to Facebook, which a page render does not depend on. Kept so existing callers keep validating.

skipContactEnrichmentWhenInactive.title: Skip contact enrichment for inactive leads
skipContactEnrichmentWhenInactive.description: After recent Facebook activity is confirmed outside the activity window, return the inactive result without expensive Facebook/Google contact enrichment.

requests.title: Batched validation requests
requests.description: Per-row logged-out HTTP input. Each item carries a Facebook proof URL, lead context, and stable requestKey. No Facebook account cookies are used.

requestKey.title: Request key
requestKey.description: Stable identifier used by the validator backend to map this Actor result back to the source lead.

url.title: Facebook URL
url.description: Facebook business page or post URL for this lead.

lead.title: Lead record
lead.description: Lead-specific identity and source fields used while validating this URL.

googleFallbackBudgetMs.title: Google fallback time budget (ms)
googleFallbackBudgetMs.description: Time budget for the identity-matched official-website search. A SERP through the GOOGLE_SERP proxy returns 300-500 KB, so a few seconds is not enough for it to ever succeed.

maxRequestRetries.title: Maximum attempts per Facebook request
maxRequestRetries.description: How many times a failed Facebook read is retried on a fresh exit IP before the row is reported as an error.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum leads in parallel
maxConcurrency.description: How many leads are validated at the same time. Each lead is two HTTP requests and is almost entirely network wait, so raising this shortens a batch nearly linearly until Facebook starts throttling the exit IPs.
